reason: I already have a hoodie I wear every week and I buy from Nike, Uniqlo and Carhartt because I know what I'm getting. A brand I've never heard of at $78 for a hoodie is asking me to take a risk with no reason to.
objection: Everyone says 'quality fabrics, fair prices.' How do I know the quality is really better than a Carhartt or Uniqlo piece I already trust? There's no store to touch it in, and I've got no reviews or history to go on.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real reviews from people I trust, or a free, easy return policy so I'm not stuck if the fabric feels cheap.
